test_Embedding_class: test the Embedding class to load and read numpy embedding files via mmap or memory mode
test_EmbeddingConcatenator_class: test the EmbeddingConcatenator class to merge multiple embedding shard files into a single output file
test_MissingHeaderError: test that MissingHeaderError is raised when loading an embedding file without a valid numpy header
test_Embedding_save_method: test the Embedding save method to write a sampled subset of embeddings to a new file in fp16 or fp32
test_Embedding_open_for_read: test the Embedding open_for_read context manager to access embedding data in mmap or memory mode
